g.text: Fits use estimated 2026 catch of 1,310,000 t.
Probability and magnitude of 2026–2027 spawning biomass change
Numbers above curves: approximate chance of an increase. Dots: estimated change; bars: 95% uncertainty ranges.
Wider parts of each curve show more likely changes under the local normal approximation.
